SUMMARY
Results-driven backend engineer with 13 years of experience building backend systems on Kafka,
Kubernetes, REST API design.

Principal Backend Engineer - Silverline Solutions (2024-2026)

Staff Backend Engineer - Ironwood Labs (2021-2024)

- Introduced Terraform-managed infrastructure, cutting provisioning time by 88%.
Senior Backend Engineer - Larkspur Data (2020-2021)

Backend Engineer - Northbeam Analytics (2013-2020)
- Owned the Kafka event pipeline processing 50M events/day.
- Led migration of core services at Northbeam Analytics onto AWS, improving uptime during peak load.
